name: dsh-vocab-review
description: Underlined-word vocabulary review for DeepSeek Harness: image ingestion for both underlined worksheets and plain article images (exam high-frequency words for 高考/CET-4/CET-6/考研, basic and out-of-scope words filtered), one-word-at-a-time quiz loop that keeps going while words are due, a days-based memory curve (10m/1d/3d/7d/14d/30d; a clean first answer jumps to one day, a wrong answer is a 5-minute relearning retry, no word is asked more than 3 times a day, every batch keeps slots for never-asked words, and no word is ever asked before its due date), three-tier grading (known / half-known / unknown) with plugin-side verdict verification that ignores DSH system-reminder context, per-word ease factors, persistent wrong-word ledger and weak-word book with CSV/JSON/Anki export, one-click progress reset, a last-7-days trend and diagnostics, daily quota, due reminders, and an optional self-hosted QQ bot (QQ 开放平台 AppID/AppSecret, no third-party plugin and no npm dependency, inbound text and images, cached token/gateway and automatic backoff when QQ rate limits the app) or a bridge to the third-party dsh-qq-bot plugin.
author: At

scripts.test: node test/harness.mjs && node test/sessions-stop.mjs && node test/client-load-check.mjs && node test/qq-builtin.mjs
scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check qq/client.js && node --check qq/bridge.js && node test/locale-check.mjs
